tweets.body:
6/N
Key Takeaways 🔥:
(i) Kinematic Consistency: Eliminates hallucination via robot-motion anchoring.
(ii) Zero Scene Assets: Synthesizes data without costly 3D modeling.
(iii) Effective Data Scaling: Performance improves steadily as more synthesized data is added.

tweets.body:
🎬 𝑽𝒊𝒅𝒆𝒐𝑮𝑷𝑨: A self-supervised alignment framework that gives pre-trained Video Diffusion Models real 3D consistency.

Today’s VDMs break geometry — objects drift, morph, and defy physics — limiting their use as World Models or VLAs.

We fix that. #VideoGPA https://t.co/fkySZ9k18F
